title: Composition of the constant-object derived pullback comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A and scheme maps p:T→U, v:U→S and w:T→S with w=p≫v, the derived inverse-image compositor at the constant degree-zero object followed by p-pullback of ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A v and ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A p equals ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A w. The objects and maps are those of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], with factors given by [lem-amb-ordinary-finite-unit-pullback-hom].

source.place: Overlap calculation: inverse image and the degree-zero Hom correspondence commute with restriction

proof.text: Substitute w=p≫v. Expand each constant-object comparison using the hom formula. The source lemma leftDerivedUpperStarComp_hom_app_singleFunctor identifies the derived compositor on degree-zero sheaves. Naturality of the single-degree comparison moves the constant-sheaf morphism through p-pullback. Functoriality then combines the remaining sheaf maps, whose equality is upperStarConstantSheafIso_comp. An abstract categorical helper performs exactly this algebra before specialization.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_comp (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {T U S : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ U) (v : U ⟶ S) (w : T ⟶ S)
    (hw : w = p ≫ v) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p v w hw).hom.app
        (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A p).map (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A v).hom ≫
      (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A p).hom = (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A w).hom
